build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with a target temperature and damping time for NVT molecular dynamics
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat with temperature and relaxation time parameters
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic dynamics simulations
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state for checkpointing molecular dynamics simulations using save_state and restore_state
build_berendsen_npt_thermostat: build a Berendsen NPT thermostat with temperature, pressure, and compressibility for constant pressure simulations
